summary: Travere Therapeutics filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of $400 million convertible senior notes due 2032, with an over-allotment option of up to $60 million. The notes mature May 15, 2032, carry a blank interest rate and conversion price, and are not redeemable before May 21, 2029. Conversion is conditionally based on stock price thresholds or specified events, settled in cash, stock, or a combination. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special-situation event; no special category applies.
